title: Pocketwire Advance Late Fee Holdback — Credit Risk Rule
content:
The late fees a Pocketwire Advance line has kept over the past year hold back part of the room for a new advance. The late fees kept on the line are the late fees booked on it in the twelve months before the handling date less the courtesy waivers booked on it in that window, taken to the cent. When the late fees kept reach 2.00, 40.00 is taken off the room; when they are above zero but below 2.00, 20.00 is taken off the room; when none are kept, nothing is taken off the room.

**The window.** A window of twelve months before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the handling date, up to and including the handling date. A late fee counts by the date it was booked and a courtesy waiver by the date the waiver was booked.

**What is summed.** The amounts of the late fee entries on the line dated in the window, and the amounts of the fee waiver entries on the line with the reason courtesy dated in the window.

## Holdback table

| Late fees kept | Taken off the room |
|---|---|
| 2.00 or more | 40.00 |
| Above zero and below 2.00 | 20.00 |
| None kept — zero or less | Nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Late fees booked in the window | Courtesy waivers booked in the window | Late fees kept | Taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two late fees of 1.88 each, 3.76 in all | 0.19 | 3.57 | 40.00 |
| One late fee of 2.10 | 0.21 | 1.89 | 20.00 |
| One late fee of 1.88 | 1.88 | 0.00 | Nothing |
| One late fee of 2.00 | None | 2.00 — reaches 2.00 | 40.00 |
| None | None | 0.00 | Nothing |
